feeds.title: Fox Valley Foodie
feeds.description: I am Ben. Welcome to Fox Valley Foodie, I hope you brought your appetite. Pull up your favorite recipe, and let me show you how to recreate these restaurant-caliber meals from scratch in your own kitchen.

feeds.title: Cheese Curd In Paradise
feeds.description: Hello! I am Ashley and welcome to Cheese Curd In Paradise. I am a busy mom, teacher, and cookbook author working to make family, food, and life an adventure! Here you will find family-friendly recipes for breakfast, soup, salad, appetizers, main dishes, holiday favorites, drinks, and desserts.

feeds.title: Sweetphi
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Phi. I'm a busy working mom to boy-girl twins and a toddler. I am all about helping make mealtime a little easier and sharing inspiration for those with a busy lifestyle!

feeds.title: Amanda's Cookin'
feeds.description: Browse hundreds of delicious and easy recipes and desserts, both made-from-scratch and using mixes. Amanda Formaro is a home cook and baker behind the scenes of Amanda's Cookin'. She've been baking, cooking, and creating recipes for her family and friends for over 30 years!

feeds.title: Midwest Nice Blog
feeds.description: Hey, I'm Amanda! I'm a Midwesterner, food photographer, and recipe developer. After working in restaurants for more than a decade I made it my goal to share all my kitchen know-how with folks like you! I believe in making good food for good people.

feeds.title: Dude Foods
feeds.description: DudeFoods.com is your home for ridiculous original food creations, amazing mouth-watering dishes restaurant reviews, and much more!

feeds.title: Destination Madison » Food & Drink
feeds.description: Destination Madison is your resource for exploring things to do, restaurants, events, culture, the outdoors, and more!

feeds.title: The Healthy Epicurean
feeds.description: Simple, wholesome and delicious healthy recipes and cooking resources from a registered dietitian and chef Julie. Her mission is to make your life easier and more enjoyable with simple, delicious and wholesome recipes.

feeds.title: Food Love Affair
feeds.description: I am Janet. Welcome to my brand new Wisconsin food blog, where I share recipes from classically simple to healthy and experimental. Join me on my new journey!

feeds.title: Turnips 2 Tangerines
feeds.description: Hi! I am Lynn!. I'm a Wisconsin recipe blogger, coffee drinker, spice hoarder, cookbook lover, farm market browser, thrift store shopper and grocery store stalker. Join me in my kitchen for recipes and ramblings from my everyday life.

feeds.title: Bobbers Island Grill Blog
feeds.description: A place to keep you up to date on all things Bobbers. 20 years and counting, family-owned and operated restaurant, Bobbers Island Grill is bringing a taste of the Caribbean to the Wisconsin Dells.

feeds.title: Wisconsin Foodie
feeds.description: Wisconsin Foodie is an Emmy-winning independent television series dedicated to discovering the stories behind the food we eat.

feeds.title: Thayer in the Kitchen
feeds.description: I started this blog primarily as a way to keep track of therecipes that I used and liked using the produce from ourCSA share. Join me in experiencing the wonders of fresh local produce!

feeds.title: The Live-In Kitchen
feeds.description: The Live-In Kitchen is dedicated to sharing approchable, easily customizable vegetarian and vegan recipes for feeding the people you love!

feeds.title: Madison Eats Food Tours Blog
feeds.description: Madison Eats gives you a taste of Madison, WI's incredible food scene through walking and biking restaurant tours and culinary events. It is locally owned and operated, with award-winning local food writer Otehlia Cassidy at the helm.
